name: Pasadena Denver Lanes
description: The Pasadena Denver Lane Bloods (PDLB), commonly known as the Pasadena Denver Lanes (PDL), are a predominantly African-American street gang based on the west side of Pasadena, California. The gang emerged in the late 1970s as a Pasadena-based subset of the Denver Lane Bloods from South Central Los Angeles and is one of the oldest and largest Blood sets in the San Gabriel Valley. Their territory is centered along the Fair Oaks Avenue corridor, with Kings Villages (formerly King's Manor Apartments) and Robinson Park serving as primary gathering areas.
